title: 知识调用接口的局部对抗训练
literature_assessment: literature-assessment.json: Loop stabilization has practical evidence, but this adversarial inner loop is an optional unverified extension, not an established common or necessary Loop training recipe.

material_passport.Verification Status: UNVERIFIED: proposed method; no repair training performed

authorization.current_request: 结合已有实验与论文设计不依赖真实中间实体的接口改进方法

claim_level: A falsifiable method-development proposal, extending known adversarial training and the existing calling-interface diagnosis; neither a new training principle nor an established scalable repair.
question: Does training the original answer task over local neighborhoods of the post-attention calling state reduce late-training loss of composition ability?
hypothesis: The atomic-to-compositional calling mismatch contains a locally fragile component that answer-loss training over internal neighborhoods can reduce.

evidence.observation: At fixed EMA/R8, B4 accuracy falls 71.24% to 5.66% from 256k to 500k while atomic accuracy and A4 remain 100%. At 500k, no final-wrong question was fully answered correctly in rounds 1 through 8.
evidence.interpretation: This regression is mainly failure to form the correct full answer within R8, rather than later destruction of a previously correct full answer. It does not identify the optimizer root cause.

evidence.observation: At 500k, a true-bridge atomic post-attention donor changes second-hop candidate accuracy from 21.16% to 99.98% and B4 from 5.66% to 27.96%. At 256k the same operation changes B4 from 71.24% to 88.98%.
evidence.interpretation: The whole post-attention residual is a material bottleneck. This donor is not deployable and does not explain most of the across-checkpoint regression: the donor-conditioned gap remains 61.02 percentage points.

evidence.observation: Input-only B embedding norm rollback gives B4 5.46%, versus native 5.66%.
evidence.interpretation: Simple input norm restoration did not repair the failure; this is not a proof excluding every normalization mechanism.

history_check.status: completed; reload and cloud verification passed
history_check.result: At 300k, OI plain/control/adapter are 34.30/34.67/34.43%; OO are 3.293/4.192/3.693%. No unique controller advantage was established.
history_check.difference: Keep function capacity and Q architecture fixed; change the set of internal inputs on which the original answer objective is optimized.

history_check.result: All-position alignment to the model's own decoded embeddings improved OI but harmed IO and OO; self-prediction CE had different, partly positive results and is not conflated with that alignment.
history_check.difference: Do not align hidden states to token embeddings or use decoded intermediate entities as targets; optimize original final labels under internal perturbations.

history_check.closest_work: supervised-alignment-development-v1 and simplified fixed-reader factual-module replacement
history_check.result: Oracle intermediate targets are unavailable here. Simplified fixed-reader representation constraints already gave positive results in their own setting; a unified/frozen interface is not a new question.
history_check.difference: All model parameters remain trainable; no true intermediate labels, fixed reader, or representation-matching target.

history_check.closest_work: norm-handoff-multihop-v1; existing EMA, random segment depths and detached carry
history_check.status: norm-handoff has engineering needs_attention rather than a formal negative training endpoint; EMA/random depth/detached carry are already in the current training recipe
history_check.difference: Preserve these choices and do not market them as the proposed change.

history_check.status: KV recipe expansion ended by user; multiple gate designs already completed or running
history_check.difference: No KV changes, no new gate, no automatic parameter grid.

literature.name: FreeLB, ICLR 2020
literature.borrow: Multiple projected perturbation-ascent passes, parameter-gradient averaging followed by one optimizer update, and a fixed dropout mask within the inner loop.
literature.change: Move perturbations from input word embeddings to an internal post-attention residual; use sparse attacked updates, per-token relative RMS bounds and the existing two-segment Loop objective.
literature.boundary: The original experiments are primarily language-understanding fine-tuning, not large autoregressive pretraining or this composition-regression problem. This proposal is an adaptation, not an original-experiment reproduction.

literature.name: Huginn: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning, arXiv:2502.05171v2
literature.relevance: A recurrent-depth model was trained at 3.5B parameters / 800B tokens; norms and initialization mattered at scale. Preliminary additive Gaussian state-noise experiments did not help.
literature.boundary: Large-scale recurrence is feasible, but neither this interface perturbation method nor a generic noise benefit is established. Do not bundle Huginn architecture changes into this comparison.

method.architecture: Use the existing state-MLP model, preserving all existing residual, causal attention, LayerNorm, MLP, feedback, handoff and parameter EMA operations. All parameters remain trainable.
method.clean_block: u = x + Dropout_attn(Attention(LN1(x))); H = u + Dropout_mlp(MLP(LN2(u)))
method.perturbed_block: u_tilde[t] = u[t] + sigma[t] * delta[t]; H = u_tilde + Dropout_mlp(MLP(LN2(u_tilde)))
method.scale: sigma[t] = max(RMS(u_clean[t].detach()), 1e-6), fixed within all inner passes; RMS is over hidden dimensions only, never across tokens or samples
method.bound: RMS(delta[t]) <= 0.1 for each eligible token; all ineligible delta entries are zero
method.gradient_semantics: Both the residual branch and LN2-to-MLP input see the perturbation. Scale and attack updates are stop-gradient; normal parameter gradients pass through u. No derivatives through the attack optimizer.
method.mask: For this task, perturb all non-padding prompt positions up to and including positions[:,0], the original first-answer readout position. Exclude the teacher-forced answer token and padding. This boundary uses existing supervision positions, no entity roles, hop labels, graph IDs or true bridges. Preserve answer-and-EOS loss. In dense autoregressive pretraining use non-padding causal positions and the original packed-sequence/loss masks, with no intermediate-entity annotations.
method.site: Select one block invocation uniformly among invocations in the last supervised segment, independently of labels, hop count, graph, prediction and correctness. With the current one-layer core this selects only the loop invocation; deeper models additionally sample a layer.
method.attack_frequency: Every eighth optimizer update, starting at update 8, from step zero training
method.ordinary_updates: The other seven updates use the original unperturbed two-segment answer/EOS objective.
attacked_update: Sample one minibatch and the original two segment lengths once. Save the original dropout RNG state. Select site and initialize delta using independent RNGs.

Initialize each eligible token delta in an isotropic random direction with RMS 0.05; step size alpha = 0.05; cap epsilon = 0.1. These are proposed development settings, not values inferred from a known semantic radius.

Perform exactly three complete forward/backward passes, each replaying the same minibatch, original loop schedule and dropout masks. Each pass uses the original mean of the two segment endpoint losses, divided by three for parameter-gradient accumulation. Carry remains detached between segments.

After passes 1 and 2, update delta by adding alpha times its per-token RMS-normalized loss gradient and project each eligible token to its epsilon RMS ball; stop-gradient and re-leaf delta. A zero-gradient token keeps its previous delta. There is no fourth outer-gradient pass.
Clip the accumulated parameter gradient once, then perform one AdamW update and one parameter EMA update. Clear all attack buffers before the next minibatch.

Restore the ordinary dropout RNG to the state after one original complete pass, so the next update's data/schedule/dropout random streams advance exactly as in the comparator. Attack and site RNGs have independent checkpointed states.
method.approximate_objective: (7/8) E[L_clean] + (1/8) E[(L_delta0 + L_delta1 + L_delta2)/3], where the three delta states form a first-order projected-ascent trajectory under fixed parameters/dropout; not a solved exact minimax objective
method.inference: delta = 0; no extra parameters, tokens, entity lookup, teacher, checkpoint ensemble, or inference FLOPs

scaling.training_compute: Idealized complete forward/backward count is 7/8 + 3/8 = 1.25 times the original per optimizer update, plus attack bookkeeping. This is not measured wall-clock speed or an equality of communication cost.
scaling.memory: Sequentially backward and release each graph. Additional perturbation/gradient storage O(B*T*d); do not retain three activation graphs or copy the model.
scaling.distributed: For DDP, accumulate without gradient synchronization until the final inner pass when compatible with the existing accumulation schedule. FSDP/checkpoint recomputation and parameter communication costs require separate measurement.
scaling.depth: A single perturbed invocation per attacked update controls total overhead, but its per-invocation coverage decreases with depth/loop count. Coverage must be reported; fixed 1/8 frequency does not establish scale invariance.
scaling.evidence_needed: Success in this existing world would be developmental evidence only. Fresh-world/initialization confirmation and ordinary next-token pretraining with compute-matched controls are needed before a large-LLM claim; none is queued or budgeted here.

proposed_development_comparison.baseline: Reuse original state-MLP step-zero initialization, 0-500k trajectory and full checkpoints. Do not resume historical weights without the matching optimizer/RNG; those historical snapshots do not all contain these states.
new_arms_if_separately_authorized: Same-site random-perturbation control: same 1/8 frequency, three complete passes, initial RMS 0.05, per-token cap 0.1 and step size 0.05; replace each normalized attack gradient with an independent isotropic direction, then project. Record actual RMS distributions: common cap and compute do not imply identical realized radii.
proposed_development_comparison.pairing: Start both new arms from exactly the old step-zero weights and same data, initialization, two-segment schedules and dropout streams. Preserve the original AdamW settings and 1.5m-step learning-rate horizon; a 500k development endpoint is not a shortened cosine schedule.
proposed_development_comparison.primary: Native unperturbed EMA/R8 B4 accuracy at the fixed 500k endpoint; report the entire 256k/300k/400k/500k curve and its minimum, without selecting the best checkpoint.
proposed_development_comparison.preservation: Report both atomic pools, A2-A4, B2-B3, raw and EMA, native answer/EOS NLL, and R8/R16/R32 gains and original-correct losses separately.
proposed_development_comparison.cost: Report unique examples, repeated exposures/effective tokens, updates, active/total parameters, estimated matrix FLOPs, measured GPU-hours and shared-resource conditions. Random versus adversarial arms match pass count; the reused plain baseline does not. Compare fixed-update behavior and quality versus actual compute separately.
proposed_development_comparison.support: A higher fixed endpoint with reduced late-curve deterioration and retained atomic/A performance supports development of the method. This known world is already observed; it is not an untouched confirmation test and no population significance claim is planned.
proposed_development_comparison.falsification: If only perturbed training loss or atomic/noise robustness improves while native B4 still deteriorates, the proposed local-neighborhood repair is unsupported. If random and adversarial controls tie, adversarial direction selection is not supported over that random control. Do not automatically expand radius, gate or world grids.
proposed_development_comparison.mechanism_boundary: An endpoint gain from end-to-end training does not localize learned changes to the MLP alone. Accuracy improvement does not establish that real compositional states lie inside a 10% neighborhood.

implementation_validation_if_authorized: At epsilon zero and one inner pass, original loss, segment weighting, carry detach, gradients, update and RNG progression agree with the baseline within the appropriate precision tolerance.
Exactly three complete passes and one clip/AdamW/EMA update on attacked steps; no leaked attack state across minibatches or resumption.
Per-token bounds, mask, frozen local scales and identical inner-loop dropout/schedules; no cross-example normalization or oracle data access.
Given a fixed delta, future token changes cannot alter prefix states. This is a causal-forward test, not a claim that a supervised optimized delta is independent of labels.
Evaluation has no perturbation, bridge construction, conditional correctness selection or added teacher; independent reload reproduces predictions.

A held-out longer projected-ascent diagnostic and isotropic random perturbations check whether apparent robustness depends on the short training ascent; primary success remains native composition performance.
unresolved_risks: Real atomic/compositional shifts may be large or structured rather than local perturbations; local smoothness need not align their semantic addresses.
A radius can cross distinct semantic addresses; 0.1 is an unvalidated development choice. Simultaneous independent token balls allow a total perturbation norm that grows with sequence length.

Training labels include no B compositions, so the added objective can still be satisfied without learning B composition; end-to-end optimization could learn to ignore the perturbed recurrent state rather than improve reusable calls.
Perturbing the whole post-attention residual constrains downstream computation jointly, not only MLP calls.
Long chains, continual knowledge updates and large-scale pretraining are separate unverified capabilities.
